The processing list.

Process an zelclo item to the yukka unit.
Process an kaqen item to the cloxil unit.
Process an zamnak item to the qenmi unit.
Process an solovi item to the brafex unit.

When a grade is not on the list, the unit is yuksol.

The processing list.

Process an nakxil item to the yukclo unit.
Process an ovisol item to the wrentez unit.
Process an pyrpyr item to the xilmi unit.
Process an pyrqen item to the fexbra unit.

When a grade is not on the list, the unit is wrenzam.

Example.

A part with a solbra measurement of 42 is zamtu.
